messages.content:

Which two numbers from the text do we actually need to focus on?

You're also right that the 31 isn't needed for this specific question; sometimes problems give extra information to see if you can pick out what's important. Since we want to find the difference between the morning and afternoon groups, what mathematical operation should we use?
Subtraction? But I always mess up the subtraction part. I'll probably get it wrong anyway.

Subtraction is the correct choice. Even if you make a small mistake, that's how we learn—it's just a part of the process. Why don't you try setting up the subtraction problem with those two numbers and tell me what you get? Take your time.
